response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong alignment with the Staff Software Engineer role, particularly in distributed systems, AI-driven development, and technical strategy. His current work at re:cinq on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP code generators is highly relevant, and his experience spans high-throughput systems, full-stack development, and operational ownership. While his background is diverse, the depth in key areas and exposure to AI-native environments make him a strong candidate.
strengths: Direct experience with AI-driven engineering (MCP code generators, agentic workflows at re:cinq).
Proven expertise in distributed systems and high-throughput architectures (e.g., Dunnhumby media, RIDE Capital).
Strong operational ownership and agile methodology experience (e.g., on-call readiness, scrum champion rotation at Altom Consulting).
concerns: Limited explicit mention of stakeholder management or bridging engineering/product perspectives in past roles.
Diverse technical background may dilute focus on core must-haves like Python (TypeScript is strong, but Python expertise is less documented).
No clear evidence of prior Staff-level technical strategy responsibilities (current role may be transitional).
